articles.headline: Mavericks exercise 2027-28 option on Zaccharie Risacher deal
articles.description: The Mavericks exercised the fourth-year team option in forward Zaccharie Risacher's contract, guaranteeing his $17.4 million salary next season.

articles.headline: Timberwolves say Anthony Edwards will be 'good as new' after knee surgery
articles.description: The Timberwolves believe Anthony Edwards will be "good as new" following arthroscopic surgery for a lingering injury to his right knee.

articles.headline: Lakers rule out Luka Doncic, Ziaire Williams vs. Clippers
articles.description: Lakers star Luka Doncic (back) and starter Ziaire Williams (foot) will not play in Wednesday's game vs. the Clippers, who will be without Rui Hachimura (quad).

articles.headline: Updated NBA championship and MVP odds: Spurs take control; Thunder lose ground
articles.description: The San Antonio Spurs are the early favorites to win the NBA championship, with Victor Wembanyama the fave to take home MVP honors.

articles.headline: Ernie Johnson says this is his final season as 'Inside the NBA' host
articles.description: Ernie Johnson will retire as host of "Inside the NBA" after the season, saying that it was his decision to step away and that "it's just time."
